modes.cue_notes: Sit with the shins crossed comfortably in front of the body, each foot loosely tucked beneath the opposite knee or shin. Lift through the crown of the head, lengthen the spine, and let the hands rest on the knees or in the lap. Sit on the edge of a folded blanket if the low back rounds or the knees sit higher than the hips.

notes: The general-purpose seated base pose used to open and close a practice, take opening breath work, or set an intention. Distinct from a dedicated closing stillness pose — this is the default neutral cross-legged seat used at any point a simple seated position is needed.

breathing_cues.entering: Lower to a seat, cross the shins, and take a moment to settle the weight evenly across both sitbones.
breathing_cues.holding: Breathe slowly and evenly, letting each inhale lengthen the spine and each exhale soften the shoulders away from the ears.
breathing_cues.exiting: Uncross the legs slowly and switch the cross of the shins if seated for an extended period, or transition into the next pose.

modifications.name: Seated on Blanket or Block
modifications.description: Sit on the edge of a folded blanket or block to tilt the pelvis slightly forward and ease pressure on the knees and low back.

modifications.name: Blocks Under Knees
modifications.description: Support each knee with a block or bolster if the knees float well above hip height, reducing strain on the hip and knee joints.
